name: subagent-kit
description: Scoper (Haiku), implementer (Sonnet), reviewer (Sonnet, Opus for risky changes) and shipper (Haiku) subagents, with rules for when the main session delegates to them, an /issue skill that does the next step an issue's state label calls for (triage, research, a decision, chasing info, a runbook, or building it through to a PR, with a queue of issues shipped as a gh-stack stack of PRs), a /grill skill that interviews you about a plan and publishes it as issues, a /next skill that reports what is ready, in flight, blocked and waiting, a /dispatch skill that starts background sessions running /issue for the work /next recommends, a /repo-init skill that sets up a repository's labels, merge settings, issue auto-close workflow, pull request template, LF line endings on Windows and CLAUDE.md, and commits them as a PR, and a /worktree-include skill that writes .worktreeinclude
